profile.title: Profile

profile.defaultViewHint: Automatic is week on a large screen and agenda on a phone.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

device.title: This device
device.intro: These settings apply to this browser only.
device.installed: The app is installed on this device.
device.iosIntro: On iPhone and iPad, add the app to the Home Screen to install it. Notifications work only there.
device.iosShare: Tap the Share button in Safari.
device.browserMenu: Your browser can install the app from its menu, for example Install app or Add to Home Screen.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.intro: Asks for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
